77795.subject: Ramp is building the CFO for AI Agents 📊🤖; Stripe’s leaked investor letter says the Singularity started January …
77795.body:
View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/fintechpulse1116

Hey Everyone,
Good morning & happy Friday! Today, we’re diving into Ramp's launch of Router.com to see why the product they shipped alongside it, not the router LLM itself, is the bigger move here (the Stripe vs Ramp routing war, how USDC agent wallets turn AI agents into controlled corporate spenders, who wins between developers and CFOs + bonus deep dives into How to Build an Agentic OS with Claude Fable 5 [ https://substack.com/redirect/460e1710-37f4-4322-ac9b-4945d60afd87?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] & The AI Monopoly Playbook [ https://substack.com/redirect/b8b76725-24bc-4aff-b51b-0efa4d8684cc?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside), and Stripe's leaked investor letter to see why Patrick Collison told his investors the singularity started on January 1st and what that means for the $7B OpenRouter deal (Stripe's H1 2026 financials, the "two currencies" thesis that reframes the entire acquisition, plus the product stack that turns tokens into a payment rail + bonus deep dive into The Ultimate Guide to Qwen3.8-27B [ https://substack.com/redirect/5f03e78c-4d0c-4418-8434-22281c7d5473?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside). So let’s jump straight into the finnovative stuff 🌶️
Ramp is building the CFO for AI Agents 📊🤖
The news 🗞️ When we first covered Ramp Router [ https://substack.com/redirect/bc13d98a-fbf7-4cfd-813c-1d522d21a13a?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] on July 22, we clearly said it is not a product but rather a wedge into AI spend management. A month later, the picture is even bigger than we thought.
On Wednesday, Ramp launched Router.com, an AI model routing service built on 3 years of internal production use. Hours earlier, Stripe had officially confirmed its $7.5B acquisition of OpenRouter [ https://substack.com/redirect/83a63b66-0f63-49d1-b8df-9b2c21b1ef23?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], the developer-favorite model marketplace, at nearly 6x the valuation it held just three months prior.
These two companies are not strangers. Stripe co-led Ramp’s 2021 Series B at a $1.6B valuation and still provides card-issuing and stablecoin infrastructure that Ramp relies on today.
Now they want the same layer: the routing decision that determines which AI model gets paid per request. And that’s before you account for what Ramp shipped alongside the router. That second product may actually matter more than the router itself...

Unsubscribe https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9saW5hcy5zdWJzdGFjay5jb20vYWN0aW9uL2Rpc2FibGVfZW1haWw_dG9rZW49ZXlKMWMyVnlYMmxrSWpveE1Ea3dOVFV6TURnc0luQnZjM1JmYVdRaU9qSXhNakV3Tnprd05Td2lhV0YwSWpveE56ZzNNekEyTWpFd0xDSmxlSEFpT2pFNE1UZzROREl5TVRBc0ltbHpjeUk2SW5CMVlpMDRNVGd4T1NJc0luTjFZaUk2SW1ScGMyRmliR1ZmWlcxaGFXd2lmUS5sQUZFbmtTcjU2UThMOGtkVkpXdEdOM

77793.subject: 🔎 ChatGPT gets 100 billion extra sources
77793.body:
----------
######           [Subscribe](https://academynews.genai.works/)   -    [Collaborate with us](https://utm.genai.works/r/cq9vsh4)


--------------------
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8776fa6e-e2d0-4aec-9648-1bed6de3a659/GenAI_Daily_Banner.jpg?t=1778687445)
Caption: 


----------

----------
**Welcome back!** ChatGPT and Codex can now search 100 billion sources through one plugin. Anthropic is chasing the biggest IPO in history, UK cinemas are moving against Meta's camera glasses, and Claude Academy just went live, free, all of it.

**In today's Generative AI Newsletter:**

* **ChatGPT:** What just gave it 100 billion new sources?

* **Anthropic:** How big is the IPO it's about to file?

* **Meta:** Why are cinemas turning its glasses away?

* **Claude:** What did Anthropic just make free for everyone?


----------



----------
## ChatGPT just got 100 billion new sources

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/1e93d0a5-56b2-401e-977c-1e4e709a2ea0/ChatGPT_Image_Aug_21__2026__01_07_48_AM.png?t=1787263896)
Caption: 

OpenAI spent Thursday [pointing developers](https://x.com/openaidevs/status/2090480484107141493) at someone else's search engine. The Exa plugin opens more than 100 billion websites, docs, papers, people and companies to ChatGPT Work and Codex.

Setup takes about a minute. Open Codex, go to Plugins, find Exa, hit install. Terminal people can run codex mcp add exa --url https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp instead.

What changes is where answers come from. Instead of leaning on what the model remembers, your agent pulls current sources mid-task. That matters most when you ask about a company, a person or a paper newer than its training data.

The gap between an agent that guesses and an agent that checks is most of what makes these things useful.
